name: opencode-sandbox
description: OpenCode 2 plugin that sandboxes agent commands using @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime (seatbelt on macOS, bubblewrap on Linux)

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/tui.tsx --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime --external @opencode/plugin --external '@opencode/plugin/*' --external @opentui/core --external '@opentui/*' --external solid-js && bun x tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
scripts.test: sh -c 'for f in test/*.test.ts; do bun test "$f" || exit 1; done'
scripts.test:coverage: sh -c 'for f in test/*.test.ts; do bun test --coverage "$f" || exit 1; done'
scripts.postinstall: patch-package || echo '[opencode-sandbox] could not apply the local sandbox-runtime patch (patch-package unavailable) — CIDR network entries will be rejected by the runtime; see README "Local patch"'

author: Ivan Sanchez <ivan31.sanchez@gmail.com>
